messages:
alice: Heads up — planned deploy starts in ~30m. API v2.3 (minor proto change), runtime kernel bump (attention opt + kv-cache tweak), router rate-limit tweak, and console metric rename. Need cross-service interlock before we kick.

deploy-bot: Scheduled window confirmed: start=4285001800 end=4285005400, ticket=RDW-4578. /deploy prepare will run at T-5m.

ben (runtime): Re: kernel bump — pushed a compat build to staging. No behavioral changes expected, but KV eviction threshold moves from 0.7 -> 0.65. If we see tail latency > 30ms or eviction spikes, we should abort.

carla (router): Router change is a tighter rate limiter for bursty clients, will affect slow clients only. Plan: 10% canary for 10m, then 50/50 for 10m, then full if healthy. Canary route is /canary-router.

erin (console): Console will rename metrics: api_request_count -> http_requests_total and expose a tag for model_name. Dashboard panels updated in PR #872. FYI eval dashboards may break if pinned to old metric name.

sre-oncall: Let's define a concrete abort signal: if api_5xx_rate goes >0.5% sustained for 5m OR host_cpu_p95 increases > 85% during canary, we stop and roll back. Also keep an eye on router_errors.

dave (devops): Firewall change from last week unrelated, but I unlocked the maintenance window in prod for 1h after deploy in case we need a quick patch.

alice: Agree on abort signals. Ben/carla — can you both add a short smoke test that hits the /health and a sample long-context generation path? I'll attach them to the deploy job.

ben (runtime): Added smoke tests to runtime repo: `scripts/smoke_gen.sh --tokens 512` and `curl <runtime-host>/health`. Linked in RDW-4578.

carla (router): Router smoke: `wrk -t2 -c50 -d30s https://router/canary-router/health` and a small request that exercises sticky sessions. I'll add to deploy job.

erin (console): Added a migration note to the release notes; console will emit both old+new metric names for 48h to smooth dashboards. Release notes: https://ourdocs/release/rdw-4578

deploy-bot: /deploy start scheduled at 4285001800. Canary step will create canary flag `rdw_canary=deploy-4285`. Notify here once it hits prod.

sre-oncall: Quick check: what's our rollback plan if metrics fail? Manual rollback to previous pinned model: `router.pin=stable-2026-04`, `runtime.image=runtime:v1.19.2`. Who will execute?

alice: Ops (dave) will run the rollback commands. Ben/carla — please keep a warm build of the previous kernel/image pinned and available.

dave (devops): Roger — I'll have rollback playbook open and credentials ready. Also enabling a temporary traffic hedge so we can shift 30% to dedicated capacity if needed.

sre-oncall: I'll monitor the alerting channel and run the quick traces. If canary fails, we abort, pin previous artifacts, and post a short incident note.

alice: Final check — is everyone okay with the change window and abort thresholds?

ben (runtime): :+1:

carla (router): :thumbsup:

dave (devops): :ok_hand:

erin (console): :eyes: I'll watch dashboards during canary.

sre-oncall: On call and ready.

alice: Ok starting preflight at T-10. I'll post once /deploy prepare runs.
